summary: Agent Builder Tool: Create, configure, publish, and manage custom AI agents end to end. create_new drafts a private agent, optionally as a remix of any agent you can view. Use when an agent needs agent builder tool, build a custom ai agent without writing code, turn a job description into a working ai agent, equip an agent with crm inbox calendar and messaging tools, attach multi step workflows to an agent, add product, agent id, product id through AgentPMT-hosted remote tool calls.
